description: Land Title Settlement Department - Hanchapola, Meerigama D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510202
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels, including detailed information about land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, and property details. The content focuses on land registration and title settlement, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and land title matters.
